description: Interior view of the Abiquiu dining room corner fireplace; closeup view of white kiva fireplace with four objects on the mantel, a white cloth bag, and three dark smooth stones - a large flat one, a medium flat one, and medium round one, large plastered hearth in foreground with fireplace utensils leaning to the side of the fireplace. revealing Estiben's lovely arrangement of pinion firewood.
title: Corner Fireplace In The Dining Room
